operator_setup: User says this is a repeat to check repeatability. Prior run used hand restraint with operator-reported stationary cube; same restraint in this run is inferred from context, not independently confirmed.
interpretation: Peak opposing load reproduced to about 2.2 percent across these two runs. Both curves load and subsequently weaken, but the same-window mean load is about 7 percent lower in the repeat and the force-drop stop occurs about 1 mm earlier. This supports a provisional peak target near 8 N; the complete force-versus-travel curve is approximately repeatable, not identical.
limitation: Two runs do not establish a statistical repeatability tolerance or instrument accuracy. The initial off-axis force and torque differ, so equivalent motor stopping positions do not establish identical contact/restraint geometry. Exact sliding onset was not timestamped; force-drop trigger is not a static breakaway measurement.
